headline: Geojit Financial Services discloses substantial acquisition under SEBI Regulation 31(4)
sum: Geojit Financial Services has filed a SEBI Takeover Regulation 31(4) disclosure on NSE, indicating a substantial acquisition of shares or voting rights triggering mandatory disclosure; full details of acquirer, consideration and shareholding pattern not yet publicly available.
detail: The NSE filing confirms Geojit Financial Services Limited submitted a formal disclosure under SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, Regulation 31(4) on or around 1–3 July 2026. Regulation 31(4) mandates disclosure once a person acquires 25% or more of voting capital or where an existing 25% holder acquires additional shares crossing thresholds. The substance of the acquisition — parties, price, share count, offer structure — is pending the full disclosure document review.
